column5: DBG-4 reverted (the W1C of sberror overwrites a bus error completing in the same cycle): a_dm_bus_error must fail
FC-1 dropped (a POR without the DM reset): a phantom request must be found (the assumption is needed; reset_ctrl must keep it)
DBG-6 reverted (ack reset by the DM reset, adopted on every arming edge): a_cdc_ack_genuine must fail
only rising request toggles make a pulse (every second request lost): a delivery property must fail
adopt-on-reset removed: after a DM reset ack stays out of step (DTM busy for ever or replay)
ack toggled for a request pulse too (two acknowledgements per request)

pulse taken from the first synchroniser stage (req_s[1]^req_s[0]), one stage before the adoption point: a toggle between arming edges is lost, a_cdc_hside_done must fail. NOT a metastability result: a 0/1 injection model cannot show a missing stage (one metastable value read two ways by two fan-outs); that is D3 (MTBF, pdk_arrival), recorded 2026-11-01
the DTM moves req_data while a request is outstanding: a_req_payload_held must fail
an sbcs W1C clears sberror whatever bits are written: the bench must report it
an sbaddress0 write while busy does not set sbbusyerror: the bench must report it
auto-increment adds 8: the bench must report it
sbreadondata ignored: the bench must report it
DBG-3 reverted: dmactive = 0 leaves sbaddress0/sbdata0: the bench must report it
an unaligned sbaddress0 is not refused (kick): the bench must report it
an unsupported sbaccess is not refused (kick): the bench must report it
haltreq ignored: the bench must report it
an unimplemented address reads its address, not 0: the bench must report it
ndmreset taken from bit 2: the bench must report it
IDCODE wrong: the bench must report it
Test-Logic-Reset does not select IDCODE: the bench must report it
an AHB ERROR on the SBA master is not reported: the bench must report it
SBA read data never captured: the bench must report it
DBG-7 reverted: a dmcontrol write without haltreq releases the halt: the bench must report it
resumereq does not clear allresumeack (a stale ack from the last resume): the bench must report it
DBG-8 reverted: no allresumeack: the bench must report it
DBG-7 reverted: a_dm_halt_sticky must fail
DBG-8 reverted: a_dm_resumeack_set must fail
resumereq leaves the old ack: a_dm_resumeack_clear must fail
